answer: Require each new identity to complete a verifiable delay function — a sequential computation that cannot be parallelised — before it may answer. Like a lone plume carried on a long voyage, the proof takes real wall-clock time to produce, so an attacker spinning up a thousand sybils pays a thousandfold delay, while an honest agent waits once. Proofs queue in a lagoon of quiet verification: each is checked, and only those whose delay verifies join the economy.
